title: Efficient implementation of single particle Hamiltonians in exponentially reduced qubit space
summary: Current and near-term quantum hardware is constrained by limited qubit counts, circuit depth, and the high cost of repeated measurements. We address these challenges for solid state Hamiltonians by introducing a logarithmic-qubit encoding that maps a system with $N$ physical sites onto only $\lceil \log_2 N \rceil$ qubits while maintaining a clear correspondence with the underlying physical model.
